63:1: When the hypocrites came to you, they said, 'We bear witness that you are indeed the messenger of Allah.' Allah knows that you are indeed His messenger, and Allah bears witness that the hypocrites are indeed liars.
63:2: They took their oaths as a shield and hindered from the way of Allah. Surely, what evil things they were doing.
63:3: This is because they believed and then disbelieved; thus their hearts have been sealed, so they do not understand.
63:4: When you see them, their bodies please you; when they speak, you listen to their words, as if they were timbers propped against (a wall). They think every cry is against them. They are the enemy, so beware of them. May Allah destroy them; how they are turned away!
63:5: When it is said to them, 'Come, let the Messenger of Allah ask forgiveness for you,' they turn their heads and you see them grown arrogant.
63:6: Whether you ask forgiveness for them or do not ask forgiveness for them, it is the same for them. Allah will never forgive them. Undoubtedly, Allah does not guide the transgressing people.
63:7: They are the ones who say, 'Do not spend on those who are with the messenger of Allah so that they disperse.' Whereas the treasures of the heavens and the earth belong to Allah, but the hypocrites do not understand.
63:8: They say: 'If we return to Medina, surely the most honorable one will definitely expel the most humiliated one from there.' Whereas honor belongs to Allah, to His Messenger, and to the believers, but the hypocrites do not know.
63:9: O you who believe! Let not your wealth and your children keep you from the remembrance of Allah. Whoever does that, then they are the losers.
63:10: Spend from what We have provided you as sustenance before death comes to one of you, so that he then says, 'My Rabb! If only You would delay me for a near term, so that I may give charity and be among the righteous.'
63:11: Allah never delays any soul when its appointed time has come, and Allah is aware of what you do.
